standard.summary: 启用低内存（RAM）模式，将大部分权重保留在 GPU 显存而非系统内存，降低 CPU RAM 占用。
standard.effect: 开启后主要权重不缓存到 CPU RAM，节省系统内存约 50%。适合 CPU RAM 较小（<16GB）的机器。
standard.whenToUse: 系统内存有限（<16GB）且 GPU 显存充足时开启。
standard.avoidWhen: GPU 显存不足时，low_ram 反而会增加 GPU 压力。系统内存充足时无需开启。

standard_en.summary: Enables low-memory (RAM) mode, keeping most weights in GPU VRAM rather than system memory to reduce CPU RAM use.
standard_en.effect: With this on the main weights are not cached to CPU RAM, saving roughly 50% of system memory. Suited to machines with little CPU RAM (<16GB).
standard_en.whenToUse: When system memory is limited (<16GB) and GPU VRAM is plentiful.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When GPU VRAM is short, low_ram only adds GPU pressure. There is no need for it when system memory is plentiful.

advanced.principle: 正常训练会在 CPU RAM 保留权重副本用于快速加载；low_ram 模式减少这些 RAM 副本，依赖 GPU 的 VRAM 作为主要工作区。
advanced.tradeoffs: 低 RAM 模式可能影响训练速度（数据传输路径改变）；在某些情况下反而增加 GPU-CPU 数据交换。

advanced_en.principle: Normal training keeps a weight copy in CPU RAM for fast loading; low_ram mode reduces these RAM copies, relying on GPU VRAM as the main workspace.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Low-RAM mode may affect training speed (changed data-transfer paths); in some cases it actually increases GPU-CPU data swapping.
